lines:
  - id: eic.step5_line1
    printed: "(Step 5, 1)"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 1z"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line1z}
    refuses: [scope.schedule1]
    shown_when: eic.h_steps14_ok
    note: "Clergy and church employees (Step 5, question 1) enter a reduced amount. They are outside scope through scope.schedule1, which screens minister and church employee income, so this line copies line 1z."

  - id: eic.step5_line2
    printed: "(Step 5, 2)"
    label: "Enter the Medicaid waiver payment amounts excluded from income on Schedule 1, line 8s, unless you choose to include these amounts in earned income, in which case enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [scope.other_income, s1.line8_other]
    shown_when: eic.h_steps14_ok
    note: "Medicaid waiver payments and Schedule 1 line 8s are refused by the screening inputs, so the computed case is zero."

  - id: eic.step5_line3
    printed: "(Step 5, 3)"
    label: "Subtract line 2 from line 1"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.step5_line1, take: eic.step5_line2}
    shown_when: eic.h_steps14_ok

  - id: eic.step5_line4
    printed: "(Step 5, 4)"
    label: "Enter all of your nontaxable combat pay if you elect to include it in earned income"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}
    refuses: [s8812.combat_pay]
    shown_when: eic.h_steps14_ok
    note: "Nontaxable combat pay is refused by s8812.combat_pay, so the computed case is zero."

  - id: eic.earned_income
    printed: "(Step 5, 5)"
    label: "Add lines 3 and 4. This is your earned income"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.step5_line3, eic.step5_line4]}
    shown_when: eic.h_steps14_ok

  # ---------- counts, status and limits ----------
  - id: eic.h_qc_any
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of children who meet the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_has_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, question 1: at least one child meets the conditions to be your qualifying child"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_any, {const: 0, type: Count}]}

  - id: eic.h_qc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying children who have valid SSNs"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
    note: "Step 1 counts children with valid SSNs who lived with you. This line reads that as the qualifying children with a valid SSN (dependent.eic_child and dependent.eic_ssn)."

  - id: eic.h_married_sep
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfs"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "hoh"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [household.married, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_lim0_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, no children ($19,104)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim0_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, no children, married filing jointly ($26,214)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit0.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim1_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 1 child ($50,434)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim1_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 1 child, married filing jointly ($57,554)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit1.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim2_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 2 children ($57,310)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim2_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 2 children, married filing jointly ($64,430)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit2.joint}
  - id: eic.h_lim3_other
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 3 or more children ($61,555)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.other}
  - id: eic.h_lim3_joint
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Income limit, 3 or more children, married filing jointly ($68,675)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: eic.limit3.joint}

  - id: eic.h_limit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Applicable income limit (Step 1 question 1, Step 5 question 3, Worksheet B line 5)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0_joint
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim0_other
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1_joint
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim1_other
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2_joint
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim2_other
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3_joint
        - guard: {op: test, all: [{op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}, {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}]}
          then: eic.h_lim3_other

  # ---------- Step 1 ----------
  - id: eic.h_agi_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 1: Form 1040 line 11b is less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [f1040.line11b, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_ssn_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1, question 2: you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN valid for EIC purposes"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [household.all_eic_ssn, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [sa.excluded_income, scope.other_income]
    note: "Step 1 questions 3 (Form 2555) and 4 (nonresident alien) are refused through sa.excluded_income and scope.other_income."

  # ---------- Step 2 ----------
  - id: eic.h_7a_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 1040 line 7a (if a loss, enter -0-)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f1040.line7a, take: {const: 0}}

  - id: eic.h_inv
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Investment income: lines 2a + 2b + 3b + 7a"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f1040.line2a, f1040.line2b, f1040.line3b, eic.h_7a_pos]}

  - id: eic.h_inv_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2, question 2: investment income is not more than $11,950"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, le: [eic.h_inv, {param: eic.investment_limit}]}
    refuses: [sd.other_forms, scope.schedule1, scope.other_line16, scope.other_income]
    note: "Form 4797 filers (question 3) and the question 4 situations are refused: Schedule E, rental of personal property, Form 8814 and passive activities. Otherwise investment income over the limit stops the credit."

  # ---------- Step 3 ----------
  - id: eic.h_step3_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3, questions 2 to 6 permit the credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}

  # ---------- Step 4 ----------
  - id: eic.h_age_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of persons on the return born after December 31, 1960, and before January 2, 2001"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_before_2001, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [person.born_after_1960, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_age_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4, question 2: you, or your spouse if filing jointly, were at least age 25 but under 65"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_age_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    refuses: [eic.died_2025]
    note: "A death in 2025 sends the filer to Pub. 596, so the line refuses through eic.died_2025."

  - id: eic.h_step4_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 4 permits the credit (filers without a qualifying child)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "Step 4 question 6 (can be claimed as a dependent) is read from sa.dependent. It is asked only on a return that is not joint, so it concerns you alone. Dual-status aliens are refused elsewhere."

  - id: eic.h_step34_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3 or Step 4, whichever applies, permits the credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step3_ok, {const: true}]}]}
        - {op: test, all: [{op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}, {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step4_ok, {const: true}]}]}

  - id: eic.h_steps14_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 1 through 4 permit the credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_step34_ok, {const: true}]}

  # ---------- Step 5 question 2 / Worksheet B ----------
  - id: eic.h_sc_persons
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of persons on the return with a Schedule C business"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.has_sc, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_self_employed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5, question 2: self-employed at any time in 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.h_sc_persons, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
    note: "Self-employment within scope is a Schedule C business. Clergy, church employees and statutory employees are refused (scope.schedule1), as is other self-employment income (person.se_screen)."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1a
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1a: Schedule SE, Part I, line 3 (persons filing Schedule SE)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line2
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}
    note: "Schedule SE line 3 equals line 2 here, because farm income (line 1a/1b) is refused by person.se_screen. Line 1b (lines 4b and 5a: optional method and church employee income) is refused and so is zero."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1d
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1d: Schedule SE, Part I, line 13"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.se_line13
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_1e
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 1e: subtract line 1d from line 1c"
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: subtract, from: eic.h_wsb_1a, take: eic.h_wsb_1d}

  - id: eic.h_wsb_2c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 2c: net profit or (loss) from Schedule C, line 31, of self-employed persons not required to file Schedule SE"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: person
      field: person.sc_total
      where: {op: test, eq: [person.files_se, {const: false}]}
    note: "Farm and Schedule K-1 amounts are refused. Notary public profit is not separately screened, and line 2c cannot exclude it."

  - id: eic.wsb_4b
    printed: "4b"
    label: "Combine lines 1e, 2c, 3, and 4a. This is your total earned income."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [eic.h_wsb_1e, eic.h_wsb_2c, eic.earned_income]}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb_shown
    note: "Line 3 (statutory employees) is refused through scope.schedule1 and is zero. Line 4a is the Step 5 earned income."

  - id: eic.h_wsb_shown
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B applies (Steps 1-4 passed and Step 5 question 2 answered Yes)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_steps14_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_4b_pos
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b is more than zero"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [eic.wsb_4b, {const: 0}]}

  - id: eic.wsb_6
    printed: "6 (eic.wsb_6)"
    label: "Enter your total earned income from Part 4, line 4b."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: eic.wsb_4b, take: {const: 0}}
    shown_when: eic.h_wsb6_shown
    note: "Line 6 is reached only when line 4b is more than zero. The floor at zero only makes the type hold, since a zero or negative 4b stops the credit."

  # ---------- Worksheet A (Worksheet B lines 6-11 follow the same steps) ----------
  - id: eic.line1
    printed: "1"
    label: "Enter your earned income from Step 5."
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.earned_income
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.wsb_6
    shown_when: eic.h_pre_ok
    note: "Open point: Worksheet B lines 7-11 repeat Worksheet A lines 2-6, with B line 6 in place of A line 1. Choice: one chain serves both, with line 1 taking Worksheet B line 6 for filers who answered Yes to Step 5 question 2."

  - id: eic.h_earned_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 5 question 3 / Worksheet B line 5: earned income is less than the limit"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}

  - id: eic.h_part5_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B line 4b is more than zero (or Worksheet A applies)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_4b_pos, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_pre_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Every step before the EIC Table lookup permits the credit"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_steps14_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_part5_ok, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_wsb6_shown
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Worksheet B Part 5 is reached"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_pre_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: eic.h_l1_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 1, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l1_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 1, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l1_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 1, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l1_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 1, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line1, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_l1_lookup
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 1 in the column for the number of qualifying children with valid SSNs"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l1_t0
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l1_t1
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l1_t2
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l1_t3

  - id: eic.line2
    printed: "2"
    label: "Look up the amount on line 1 above in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
              - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}
          then: eic.h_zero
        - guard:
            op: test
            all:
              - {op: test, ge: [eic.line1, {param: eic.table_start}]}
              - {op: test, lt: [eic.line1, eic.h_limit]}
          then: eic.h_l1_lookup
    shown_when: eic.h_pre_ok
    note: "The table begins at $1, so an amount below $1 has no credit. An amount at or above the income limit cannot take the credit, so it is zero and no lookup is made past the table."

  - id: eic.eligible
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can take the earned income credit (no STOP was reached)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_pre_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, gt: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
    note: "Read as: every flowchart step passes and Worksheet A line 2 (or B line 7) is not zero. The election not to claim the EIC has no input in this slice."

  - id: eic.line3
    printed: "3"
    label: "Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b."
    type: Dollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f1040.line11b}
    shown_when: eic.eligible

  - id: eic.line4
    printed: "4"
    label: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same?"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [eic.line3, eic.line1]}
    shown_when: eic.eligible

  - id: eic.h_line3_over
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 question answered No: line 3 is not less than $10,620 ($17,730 MFJ) with no children, or $23,350 ($30,470 MFJ) with 1 or more"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold0.joint}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold0.other}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold1.joint}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, gt: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
            - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, ge: [eic.line3, {param: eic.ws_threshold1.other}]}

  - id: eic.h_line5_shown
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 5 is completed (line 4 No and line 3 not below the threshold)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.line4, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line3_over, {const: true}]}

  - id: eic.h_l3_t0
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 3, no qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_0, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l3_t1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 3, one qualifying child"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_1, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l3_t2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 3, two qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_2, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}
  - id: eic.h_l3_t3
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 3, three or more qualifying children"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: table_lookup, table: eic_3, key: eic.line3, status: f1040.status}

  - id: eic.h_l3_lookup
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Table credit on line 3 in the column for the number of qualifying children with valid SSNs"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 0, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_t0
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 1, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_t1
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 2, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_t2
        - guard: {op: test, ge: [eic.h_qc_count, {const: 3, type: Count}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_t3

  - id: eic.line5
    printed: "5"
    label: "No. Look up the amount on line 3 in the EIC Table to find the credit. Be sure you use the correct column for your filing status and the number of qualifying children you have who have valid SSNs. Enter the credit here."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line5_shown, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_l3_lookup
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line5_shown, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
    shown_when: eic.h_line5_shown
    note: "Where line 5 is left blank, its value is zero and is not used by line 6."

  - id: eic.h_line6_smaller
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The smaller of lines 5 and 2"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [eic.line5, eic.line2]}

  - id: eic.line6
    printed: "6 (eic.line6)"
    label: "This is your earned income credit."
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line5_shown, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.h_line6_smaller
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.h_line5_shown, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.line2
    shown_when: eic.eligible

  - id: eic.credit
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Earned income credit for Form 1040, line 27a"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: true}]}
          then: eic.line6
        - guard: {op: test, eq: [eic.eligible, {const: false}]}
          then: eic.h_zero
    note: "Any STOP in Steps 1 to 5 or on Worksheet A/B (line 2 or 7 zero, line 4b zero or less) makes the credit zero."

  - id: eic.check_27c
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box on Form 1040, line 27c"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_age_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.us_home, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_steps14_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_self_employed, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_4b_pos, {const: false}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_earned_ok, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_pre_ok, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.line2, {const: 0}]}
    note: "The box is checked only where the text says so at a STOP: Step 1 question 2, Step 3 question 6, Step 4 questions 3 and 5, Worksheet B lines 4b and 5, and Worksheet A line 2 / B line 7 being zero. It is not checked at other STOPs. The election not to claim the EIC has no input here. Nonresident aliens are refused rather than checked."

  - id: eic.separated_box
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Check the box in the Dependents section for the special rule for separated spouses"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_agi_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_ssn_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_inv_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_has_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, ne: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.h_married_sep, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.same_home, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [eic.legally_separated, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [eic.qc_of_another, {const: false}]}
    note: "Open point: Step 3 question 6's 'No' answer says to check the separated-spouses box. Choice: following 'Special rule for separated spouses', the box is checked only for a married filer not filing jointly who reached question 6 through question 3 'Yes' with a qualifying child. That filer either lived apart for the last 6 months or is legally separated."
```
